Mapper

Source: R/widget_mapper_ui.R
mapper.Rd

Constructs a widget for managing layers on a [mapgl::mapboxgl()] map. This widget is designed to be used in conjunction with an existing map within a Shiny web application.

Usage

mapper(
  project,
  map_id,
  max_layers = 15L,
  width = NULL,
  height = NULL,
  id = NULL
)

Arguments

project

[new_project()] object.

map_id

`character` HTML identifier for [mapgl::mapboxglOutput()]. Defaults to `NULL` since these identifiers are not used by Shiny.

max_layers

`integer` maximum number of layers to be active on the [mapgl::mapboxglOutput()] at a single point in time. Defaults to 15.

width

`character` width of the displayed widget. Defaults to `NULL` such that the widget is automatically sized.

height

`character` width of the displayed widget. Defaults to `NULL` such that the widget is automatically sized.

id

`character` HTML identifier for the widget. Defaults to `NULL` since these identifiers are not used by Shiny.

See also

Other mapper: mapper-shiny, mapper_add_solution(), mapper_sync()

Examples

# \dontrun{
library(shiny)

# run example app showing a mapper
runApp(system.file("examples", "mapper_app.R", package = "apscp"))
